title: Deo Surya Mandir Darshan
style: 3D animated devotional movie style, Pixar quality, soft cinematic lighting, rich warm colours, no text, no letters, no writing
hook: Deo Surya Mandir: pashchim mukhi kyun?

scenes.prompt: Close-up of a serene Surya dev murti in a temple sanctum, golden radiant face in the middle of the frame, ornate golden crown with sun-ray halo, red marigold garlands, warm golden light of a setting sun entering from the west
scenes.tts: देव सूर्य मंदिर! बिहार का वो मंदिर, जो पश्चिम की ओर मुख किए है।
scenes.sub: Deo Surya Mandir! Bihar ka wo mandir, jo pashchim ki or mukh kiye hai.
scenes.animate: a very slow gentle camera push-in, the face stays still and serene, the soft golden glow gently pulses, a few marigold petals drift in the foreground

scenes.prompt: Wide view of an ancient stone Sun temple with a tall pyramidal spire in a small Bihar town at golden sunset, a water pond in front, devotees in colourful clothes standing quietly
scenes.tts: औरंगाबाद ज़िले के देव में है यह मंदिर। छठ पर यहाँ भक्त दूर-दूर से आते हैं।
scenes.sub: Aurangabad zile ke Deo mein hai yeh mandir. Chhath par yahan bhakt door-door se aate hain.

scenes.prompt: Divine architect Vishwakarma at night building a stone temple under a starry sky, glowing golden light, calm devotional mood, no violence
scenes.tts: मान्यता है, एक ही रात में विश्वकर्मा जी ने इसे बनाया।
scenes.sub: Manyata hai, ek hi raat mein Vishwakarma ji ne ise banaya.
scenes.animate: stars twinkle softly in the night sky and a warm golden glow gently pulses around the temple

scenes.prompt: Devotional Chhath scene at a river ghat at dawn, women in saffron and red sarees holding bamboo soop baskets with fruits and diyas, golden sunrise over calm water, Surya dev's glow in the sky
scenes.tts: आज नहाय खाय है। छठ की शुरुआत, सूर्य देव और छठी मैया की भक्ति के साथ।
scenes.sub: Aaj Nahay Khay hai. Chhath ki shuruaat, Surya dev aur Chhathi Maiya ki bhakti ke saath.
scenes.animate: the water ripples softly, the diya flames flicker gently and the golden sunrise light shimmers on the river

scenes.tts: ॐ सूर्याय नमः! लाइक, शेयर और सब्सक्राइब करें। जय देव सूर्य मंदिर!
scenes.sub: Om Suryaya Namah! Like, Share aur Subscribe karein. Jai Deo Surya Mandir!
